Let \(u=x-1\). Then
\[
f(x)=\frac{x}{x-1}=1+\frac1u.
\]
Also,
\[
f(2a-x)=\frac{2a-x}{2a-x-1}=1+\frac{1}{2a-x-1}.
\]
Since \(x=u+1\),
\[
2a-x-1=2a-(u+1)-1=2a-u-2.
\]
Thus
\[
f(x)+f(2a-x)=2+\frac1u+\frac{1}{2a-u-2}.
\]
For this to be constant, the nonconstant part must vanish:
\[
\frac1u+\frac{1}{2a-u-2}=0.
\]
This requires \(2a-2=0\), so \(a=1\). Then the sum is \(2\), so
\[
2b=2 \implies b=1.
\]
Therefore,
\[
a+b=1+1=2.
\]

\[
\boxed{2}
\]
